tasks.task: Mobilise and position boom lift on hardstand
tasks.scope: Deliver EWP boom lift to site, position on level hardstand, confirm stability and ground bearing capacity.
hazards: Boom lift tip-over or rollover on uneven or soft ground
Collision with building, parked vehicles, or pedestrians during positioning
Inadequate ground bearing capacity causing subsidence or sinkage
Overhead power line strike during boom deployment
tasks.dominant_hazard: Boom lift tip-over or rollover causing serious injury or fatality
controls: Obtain current EWP operator licence (WP class) and verify competency before positioning boom lift.
Check ground bearing capacity and subsidence risk using site survey or engineer assessment before delivery.
Confirm level hardstand surface within 1° cross-slope tolerance using laser level before positioning.
Position boom lift with outriggers fully extended and locked on firm, level ground away from building and pedestrian zones.
Establish exclusion zone minimum 1.5 × machine height around boom lift perimeter using barriers and signage.
Confirm overhead power line clearance minimum 3 m (or per local supply authority) before any boom deployment.
Check all safety devices functional: alarms, emergency descent, tilt sensors, load indicators working.
Brief all personnel on exclusion zone, pedestrian management, and stop-work triggers before operation starts.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not position boom lift until: site survey confirms bearing capacity ≥ machine weight and ground is level within 1°
⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not deploy boom until: overhead power line clearance ≥ 3 m confirmed and exclusion zone established
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: ground subsidence, tilting, or uneven settlement observed during positioning
🛑 STOP WORK if: operator licence expired, invalid, or competency not verified
🛑 STOP WORK if: boom lift movement within 3 m of overhead power lines or structures
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded
admin: Obtain working at heights permit signed by supervisor before first elevated task.
Obtain SafeWork NSW high-risk construction work (HRCW) notification and approval before mobilisation.
Record ground bearing capacity assessment, survey data, and EWP pre-use check on site documentation.
Conduct toolbox talk covering exclusion zone rules, pedestrian controls, and tip-over prevention.
tell building occupants and public of boom lift operation via signage and warning broadcast.
Close and barricade balconies directly below active work zone before elevated work starts each day
tell affected residents before any noise/dust generating work on their level or adjacent levels

monitoring.critical_control: Exclusion zone barriers complete, signage visible, access controlled
monitoring.evidence: Site survey report, engineer sign-off, laser level reading, exclusion zone barriers visible and signed

responsibility.SUP: Verify exclusion zone complete, barriers intact, access controlled before work starts
responsibility.WKR: Set up and maintain barriers, stop work if zone breached, report access issues

tasks.task: Establish site access control and exclusion zones
tasks.scope: Establish pedestrian barriers around lift footprint and roof access zone. Mark overhead power line exclusion zone on street frontage. Brief tenants on work timing and access restrictions.
hazards: Pedestrians or tenants enter exclusion zone and struck by boom lift boom or materials
Overhead power line strike during barrier installation near street frontage
Inadequate briefing to tenants leading to unauthorised access during work
tasks.dominant_hazard: Pedestrian struck by moving boom lift or falling materials from height
controls: Barricade lift footprint perimeter with rigid barriers minimum 1.2 m high before EWP arrival.
Install warning signs at each barricade point: 'Danger — Lift Operating' visible from 10 m.
Mark overhead power line exclusion zone on street frontage with high-visibility tape and ground markers.
Brief all on-site tenants and staff in writing and verbally on work timing, exclusion zones, and no-entry periods before work starts.
Designate and brief a tenant liaison contact for emergency notifications and access queries during work.
Post exclusion zone signage at all tenant entry points and lift lobbies on affected floors.
Confirm pedestrian traffic flow does not cross lift exclusion zone; redirect foot traffic if needed.
Establish radio or phone contact between site supervisor and tenant reception for real-time access control.
tell building occupants / body corporate / strata manager of work schedule, access restrictions, and expected noise/dust at least 48 hours before work starts
Notify building occupants / body corporate / strata manager of work schedule, access restrictions, and expected noise/dust at least 48 hours before work starts
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not position EWP until: barricades are installed, tested stable, and all on-site occupants have received written and verbal briefing with documented sign-off.

⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not work near overhead power line until: exclusion zone is marked, verified by supervisor, and distance to live lines confirmed safe by licensed electrician or SafeWork NSW powerline clearance tool.
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: pedestrian, tenant, or unauthorised person enters exclusion zone during lift operation.
🛑 STOP WORK if: barricades are moved, damaged, or missing during the work shift.
🛑 STOP WORK if: tenant briefing records cannot be produced on request or new tenants arrive without induction.
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded
admin: Obtain Working at Heights Permit signed by competent person before EWP operation.
Obtain Noise Management Plan if any pile or impact work is planned; distribute to affected tenants.
Maintain tenant briefing log with names, dates, times, and signatures; retain on file.
Document exclusion zone layout on site plan with marked powerline distance and pedestrian diversion route.
Conduct daily pre-start meeting with all workers to confirm briefing currency and exclusion zone compliance.
Close and barricade balconies directly below active work zone before elevated work starts each day
tell affected residents before any noise/dust generating work on their level or adjacent levels
Residents responsible for clearing personal items, furniture, potted plants, and non-common fixtures from balcony and work areas before each phase — area left/excluded if not cleared
Temporary access to neighbouring properties required — confirm access arrangements before starting
Vegetation trimmed away from surfaces designated for painting or remedial works before commencement — area excluded if vegetation impedes access
On-site parking or provision of parking permits required for duration of works
Final inspection and agreed scope of works to be confirmed before commencement
ppe: Hard hat — labelled with site name.

monitoring.critical_control: Exclusion zone barriers complete, signage visible, access controlled
monitoring.frequency: before each work shift and continuously during EWP operation
monitoring.evidence: Daily site walk-around checklist signed by supervisor; photographic record of barricades and signage; tenant briefing log with dated signatures; exclusion zone compliance record in daily report.

responsibility.SUP: Verify exclusion zone complete, barriers intact, access controlled before work starts
responsibility.WKR: Set up and maintain barriers, stop work if zone breached, report access issues

tasks.task: Access roof perimeter and survey existing guttering and flashings
tasks.scope: Use boom lift to raise worker to roof perimeter. check all damaged guttering, flashings, and box gutter condition. Mark removal zones and confirm access route for material removal.
hazards: Worker fall from boom lift platform due to loss of balance, platform movement, or platform edge strike
Boom lift platform collision with building, roof edge, or antenna during positioning
Worker struck by rotating boom or jib during positioning on roof
Inadequate harness or lanyard attachment point on boom lift platform causing fall
Overhead power line strike during boom lift vertical travel
tasks.dominant_hazard: Worker fall from boom lift platform >2m to ground or lower roof level
controls: BASE CONTROLS TAGGED OUT before any worker initiates transfer step — non-negotiable. Ground spotter confirms tag-out complete and calls 'TRANSFER CLEAR' before worker moves
Confirm horizontal gap between EWP platform and roof landing does not exceed 300mm and vertical step does not exceed 100mm — re-measure if EWP has repositioned
Worker attaches lanyard to certified structural roof anchor before disconnecting from EWP anchor — worker must not be unattached at any point during transfer
Ground spotter maintains visual contact with transferring worker throughout and confirms safe landing before clearing next worker
Verify boom lift operator holds current WP class licence and EWP pre-use checklist is signed before positioning boom.
Confirm harness is rated for suspension, lanyard is 1.5m max, and attachment point on boom platform is load-rated and marked with identity tag.
Establish 10m exclusion zone around boom lift base; position traffic control and barricades before boom deployment.
Check overhead power line clearance is minimum 3m vertical and 3m horizontal before raising boom; confirm with site electrical contact if any doubt.
Wear full-body harness and secure lanyard to load-rated anchorpoint before entering boom platform; never lean outside platform rails.
Brief worker on boom movement hazards, platform egress route, and stop-work signals before boom lift commences.
Position boom slowly and check roof edge and building contact clearances continuously; stop immediately if boom strikes structure.
Mark all damaged guttering and flashing zones with survey flags or tape; record location and condition in site logbook before descending.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not initiate transfer until: EWP base controls are tagged out, ground spotter is in position, and gap/step dimensions are confirmed within limits (300mm horizontal / 100mm vertical)
⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not raise boom until: harness attachment point is load-tested and marked, operator licence is verified current, and exclusion zone is barricaded and clear of traffic.
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: boom platform strikes building, roof edge, or antenna during positioning or travel.
🛑 STOP WORK if: worker loses balance or reports platform instability, or lanyard attachment fails.
🛑 STOP WORK if: boom lift is within 3m of overhead power lines or there is uncertainty about line location.
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded
🛑 STOP WORK if: EWP base controls are not tagged out or spotter is not in position before transfer
🛑 STOP WORK if: gap between EWP platform and roof exceeds 300mm horizontal or 100mm vertical step
🛑 STOP WORK if: wind speed exceeds EWP manufacturer OEM limit — do not transfer in high wind
admin: Obtain and file Working at Heights Permit signed by site supervisor before boom lift arrives.
Verify EWP pre-use checklist completed and signed by operator; attach checklist to site file.
Conduct toolbox meeting with worker and operator on boom movement, platform instability signals, and emergency descent procedure.
tell building occupants of elevated work and provide contact for emergency stop.
Photograph or video-record damaged areas for survey documentation; do not rely on memory alone.
Close and barricade balconies directly below active work zone before elevated work starts each day
tell affected residents before any noise/dust generating work on their level or adjacent levels
ppe: Lanyard 1.5m max with double-eye connectors (AS/NZS 1891.1 rated)

monitoring.critical_control: Harness and lanyard attachment point load-rated; operator licence current; boom clearance to power lines confirmed before each lift cycle.
monitoring.frequency: Before each boom lift deployment and continuous during work
monitoring.evidence: EWP pre-use checklist signed; harness load-test label visible; operator licence copy on site; photographs of power line clearance assessment in site logbook

responsibility.SUP: Supervise Access roof perimeter and survey
responsibility.WKR: Perform Access roof perimeter and survey per SWMS

tasks.task: Prepare roof line and install new guttering
tasks.scope: Clean roof line and fascia. Install new Colorbond guttering, box gutters, and brackets to existing roof structure. Secure all fixings to manufacturer specification and structural drawing.
hazards: Worker fall from boom lift platform during bracket installation or fastening
Inadequate fixing of brackets to roof structure causing subsequent collapse of guttering
Worker struck by swinging or falling bracket or fastening tool from height
Boom lift platform collision with roof edge or building structure during installation
New guttering not secured to manufacturer specification creating ongoing fall hazard
tasks.dominant_hazard: Worker fall from boom lift platform >2m during bracket installation and fastening
controls: Verify boom lift operator holds current WP-class licence before platform deployment.
Confirm EWP pre-start check completed and tagged, with defects log signed before work starts.
Wear full-body harness with lanyard attached to fixed anchor point on boom platform always.
Install guardrails or edge protection to boom platform perimeter to prevent inadvertent step-off.
Brief all personnel on bracket swing hazard and establish exclusion zone below 5m radius of work area.
Secure brackets to fascia using fasteners matching manufacturer specification and structural drawing.
Use manufacturer-approved fastening pattern and torque settings, logged on site completion form.
Position EWP to prevent platform contact with roof edge, guttering line, or adjacent structures.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not deploy boom platform until: working at heights permit is signed and on-site, and all competencies verified.
⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not begin bracket fastening until: structural drawing fastening details reviewed and confirmed by site supervisor.
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: harness attachment point on boom is damaged, missing, or not certified fixed.
🛑 STOP WORK if: bracket fasteners do not match manufacturer specification or structural drawing.
🛑 STOP WORK if: EWP platform shows visible movement, hydraulic leaks, or alarm activation during operation.
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded
admin: Obtain and hold working at heights permit signed before each elevated task shift.
Verify operator EWP licence and working at heights competency (RIIOHS204E equivalent) current and on file.
Complete and sign EWP pre-start check log before deployment; retain defect register on-site.
Record harness pre-use check and anchor point certification in site daily log.
Document bracket fastening completion against structural drawing and manufacturer fastening schedule.
tell SafeWork NSW of work at height notifiable event if required under WHS Reg 2017 Sch 3 cl.3.

tell affected residents before any noise/dust generating work on their level or adjacent levels

monitoring.frequency: before each platform deployment and each shift start
monitoring.evidence: Signed harness check log, anchor point certification tag, EWP pre-start checklist on-site.

tasks.scope: From boom lift, install new flashings around roof penetrations, eaves, and transitions. Apply sealant to all joints and fixings per specification. Confirm all flashings are secure and watertight
hazards: Worker fall from boom lift platform during flashing installation
Sealant or flashing material falls from height onto workers or public below
Worker exposure to sealant vapour or skin contact causing irritation or sensitisation
Inadequate flashing installation creating water leak and structural damage post-work
Boom lift platform movement during sealant application causing loss of balance
tasks.dominant_hazard: Worker fall from boom lift platform >2m during flashing and sealant installation
controls: Wear full-body harness with lanyard secured to boom lift anchorage point before entering platform.
Check harness and lanyard for damage, wear, or defects before each shift start.
Review SDS for sealant product and confirm ventilation adequate before opening containers.
Wear respiratory protection (P2 mask/respirator (fit-tested) minimum) when applying sealant in enclosed or poorly ventilated areas.
Barricade ground area directly below work zone with cones and signage to prevent public access.
Secure all flashing materials and tools to platform with lanyards or tool bags to prevent dropping.
Stop platform movement and isolate controls before applying sealant to joints.
Confirm all fixings are tight and flashings are seated flush before releasing harness tension.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not enter boom lift platform until: harness pre-use check is completed and recorded, platform safety gate is closed, and site supervisor has signed off on working at heights permit.
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: harness or lanyard shows visible damage or deterioration during shift.
🛑 STOP WORK if: platform sways or moves unexpectedly during sealant application.
🛑 STOP WORK if: weather conditions change to rain, high wind (>40 km/h), or poor visibility affecting work safety.
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded
admin: Obtain signed working at heights permit before starting elevated work.
Verify EWP operator holds current WP class licence for boom lift model.
Brief all workers on fall arrest system, anchor point location, and emergency descent procedure.
Establish ground spotter to monitor work area and prevent unauthorised access below platform.
Record harness pre-use check in site safety log before each shift.
Confirm sealant SDS and product specifications available on site and understood by applicator.
Close and barricade balconies directly below active work zone before elevated work starts each day
tell affected residents before any noise/dust generating work on their level or adjacent levels

monitoring.frequency: before each shift start and after any platform repositioning
monitoring.evidence: Dated harness pre-use checklist in site safety record, supervisor sign-off on permit

responsibility.WKR: Apply sealant per specification, wear PPE, report chemical exposure

tasks.scope: From boom lift, check all new guttering, flashings, and sealant joints. Check for gaps, misalignment, and fixings security. Test gutter run-off by flushing with water.
hazards: Worker fall from boom lift platform during inspection work at height
Inspection equipment or tools fall from platform onto workers or public
Water from flushing gutters falls on workers below or leaks into building
Inadequate inspection allowing defects to remain undetected post-handover
tasks.dominant_hazard: Worker fall from boom lift platform >2m during roof inspection
controls: Verify EWP operator holds current licence and competency certification before platform operation starts.
Check harness, lanyard, and anchor points for damage or wear before each shift — do not use if damaged.
Wear full-body harness connected to secure anchor point on boom lift platform always when elevated.
Establish exclusion zone 5 metres below platform using cones and signage — restrict public and worker access.
Brief all workers on platform and ground on water flushing sequence and fall risk before starting inspection.
check guttering and flashings from platform only — do not lean beyond handrails or rest edge protection.
Place drop sheets below platform before flushing to contain water runoff and prevent leakage into building.
Flush guttering with water at low pressure — stop immediately if water flows into occupied areas or building.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not raise boom lift until: harness inspection completed and recorded, anchor points confirmed secure, and ground exclusion zone established with signage.
⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not flush guttering until: drop sheets positioned below platform, all personnel briefed on water sequence, and building water ingress points identified and protected.
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: harness or lanyard shows damage, fraying, or loose stitching.
🛑 STOP WORK if: water from flushing enters occupied building interior or flows onto workers below.
🛑 STOP WORK if: worker leans beyond platform handrails or removes harness connection while elevated.
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded
admin: Obtain working at heights permit signed by site supervisor before each elevated task.
Verify EWP operator licence matches platform class and height — record on site induction log.
Brief platform user and ground spotters on exclusion zone and water runoff plan.
Complete harness inspection checklist and sign log before platform raise.
tell building occupants of water flushing schedule — confirm no outdoor events or air-intake vents in runoff zone.
Record water test results, any defects found, and remedial actions required post-inspection.

tell affected residents before any noise/dust generating work on their level or adjacent levels
ppe: Secure lanyard (maximum 2 metre length) rated for platform attachment
Eye protection if water splash risk

monitoring.critical_control: Check harness connection remains secure and untwisted throughout inspection — visual confirmation every 10 minutes.
monitoring.evidence: Signed harness inspection log, dated platform raise/lower times, photographic record of exclusion zone, water test results recorded on defects sheet

responsibility.WKR: check per specification, photograph defects, report issues

tasks.task: Confirm rescue plan and EWP pre-start checks
tasks.scope: Brief rescue team on emergency procedure. Confirm rescue plan posted on site. Complete boom lift pre-start checklist and safety audit before first lift.
hazards: Rescue team unfamiliar with emergency procedure, delay in rescue causing serious injury or fatality
Pre-start checklist incomplete or not signed off, defective EWP used for work at height
Rescue plan not visible on site during emergency
tasks.dominant_hazard: Delayed or failed rescue from boom lift platform due to inadequate rescue plan or team briefing
controls: Brief rescue team on emergency procedure including platform descent, ground rescue, and communication protocol before first lift.
Post rescue plan on site in visible location accessible to rescue team and EWP operator during all elevated work.
Complete EWP pre-start checklist including boom articulation, platform safety rails, hydraulic pressure, alarm function, and tie-down condition.
Verify harness and lanyard are present, undamaged, and tagged with current inspection date before operator enters platform.
Test EWP lower-to-ground control and emergency descent function with no load to confirm operational safety.
Confirm working at heights permit is signed and posted on site before first lift of the shift.
Certify EWP operator holds current WP class licence and is competent in rescue from the specific EWP model.

⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not start work until: written notification delivered to all affected occupants and body corporate/strata manager

🛑 STOP WORK if: EWP pre-start checklist identifies defect, alarm malfunction, or hydraulic pressure below manufacturer specification
🛑 STOP WORK if: harness or lanyard shows damage, fraying, burns, or is untagged with current inspection date

tasks.task: Remove damaged guttering, flashings, and fixings
tasks.scope: From boom lift platform, disconnect and remove all damaged Colorbond guttering, flashings, and box gutters. Lower materials to ground into skip bin. Remove and dispose of fasteners and fixings.
hazards: Worker fall from boom lift platform during removal work
Guttering or flashing material falls from height onto workers below or public
Sharp edges on removed material causing laceration or puncture wound to hands
Boom lift platform instability due to weight imbalance of removed materials
Worker struck by removed fasteners or fixings ejected during disconnection
tasks.dominant_hazard: Worker fall from boom lift platform >2m during removal work
controls: Wear full body harness with lanyard secured to anchor point on boom lift platform before starting work.
Check harness and lanyard for damage, wear, or defects before each shift; log check in register.
Confirm boom lift is positioned stable and level; check outriggers locked and base clear of obstructions.
Barricade ground area directly below work zone with traffic cones and warning tape; post spotter.
Disconnect guttering fasteners with impact driver or spanner; do not pry or force connections.
Place removed guttering flat on platform deck; do not stack or overhang platform edge.
Lower guttering and flashing materials in secure container or cradle to skip bin on ground; use tag line to control descent.
Collect loose fasteners into container before lowering; do not throw or drop fasteners.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not start removal work until: harness checked and logged, boom lift certified, ground zone barricaded, and spotter in position.
⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not lower materials until: container is secure, tag line attached, and spotter signals clear ground.
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: harness or lanyard shows damage, fraying, or wear.
🛑 STOP WORK if: platform tilts, shifts, or feels unstable during material removal.
🛑 STOP WORK if: wind gusts exceed 10 m/s or rain/weather reduces visibility below 30 metres.
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded
admin: Obtain signed working at heights permit before boom lift deployment.
Verify EWP operator holds current licence (WP class) and SafeWork NSW certification.
Brief all workers on barricade location, exclusion zone, and spotter role before work starts.
Establish ground spotter role; assign single person to monitor drop zone and signal crane operator.
Record pre-shift harness inspection in site log with date, time, and inspector name.
Confirm building occupants notified of overhead work; post warning signs on entry doors.

tell affected residents before any noise/dust generating work on their level or adjacent levels

Lanyard (max 2 m) with secure anchor attachment

tasks.scope: Lower all tools and materials from roof. Remove pedestrian barriers and exclusion zone markers. Sweep roof and ground areas. Brief tenants that work is complete.
hazards: Worker fall from height while lowering tools or materials from boom lift platform
Tool or material falls from boom lift platform onto workers below during lowering
Pedestrians enter site before exclusion zone barriers are fully removed
Roof area not properly cleaned leaving hazards for building occupants
tasks.dominant_hazard: Tool or material falls from boom lift platform onto worker below during lowering
controls: Lower tools and materials in closed containers or secured bundles using boom lift hoist with rated sling and tag line control.
Station ground spotter below lift platform to guide lowering and stop load if drift or swing occurs.
Check exclusion zone barriers are in place and secure before starting tool lowering.
Remove barriers only after all tools and materials are lowered to ground and ground spotter confirms area is clear.
Sweep roof with broom and shovel to collect all loose debris and materials into labelled waste container.
Sweep ground area around building perimeter and site entry to remove dust, debris, and trip hazards.
Brief site supervisor and building occupants that work is complete and site is safe for normal use.
Wear high-visibility vest and hard hat during all reinstatement work on and below boom lift platform.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not remove barriers until: all tools and materials are on ground and ground spotter confirms clear zone below lift platform
⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not brief occupants until: roof and ground areas are swept clean and all barriers are removed
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: load drifts or swings during lowering — do not resume until spotter and operator reposition load
🛑 STOP WORK if: pedestrians or building occupants enter exclusion zone during tool lowering — do not resume until zone is clear
🛑 STOP WORK if: harness or EWP fails daily pre-use check — tell supervisor and do not use equipment
🛑 STOP WORK if: occupant balcony below work zone is not closed and barricaded

monitoring.evidence: Verbal confirmation between spotter and operator logged in site diary; harness daily check sheet signed

tasks.scope: Perform final safety audit on EWP. Lower boom fully, stow safely. Arrange transport to depot. Confirm site is clear and secure.
hazards: Boom lift instability during final audit or boom stowage causing tip-over
Overhead power line strike during boom lowering to stowed position
Inadequate securing of boom lift for transport causing load shift during transit
Site hazards remain after boom lift removal (barriers, damaged areas)
tasks.dominant_hazard: Boom lift tip-over or collision with building or power line during demobilisation
controls: Conduct final safety audit of EWP before lowering boom: check hydraulic lines, seals, bucket condition, and harness integrity.
Verify overhead power lines are clear and isolated with site supervisor before lowering boom.
Lower boom fully and slowly, monitoring ground clearance and building proximity continuously.
Stow boom in transport lock position and secure with manufacturer-specified pins and locking devices.
Check all boom securing bolts are tight and all pins are seated before transport departure.
Confirm transport vehicle is level, within tare weight, and has appropriate restraint before loading.
Barricade lift-off and landing areas until EWP is fully removed from site.
Walk the site perimeter to confirm no residual hazards, barriers, or damaged areas remain.
hold_points: ⚠️ HOLD POINT — do not lower boom until: overhead power line clearance is confirmed by site supervisor and clearance distance is maintained at 3 metres minimum.
stop_work: 🛑 STOP WORK if: boom lowering causes loss of stability or tilting is observed.
🛑 STOP WORK if: EWP cannot be stowed to full lock position or securing pins cannot be fully seated.
admin: Obtain signed final safety audit checklist before boom lowering starts.
Brief operator and assistants on power line locations, boom stow procedure, and transport restrictions.
Record final condition of EWP and all securing pins fitted before transport departs site.
Confirm site clearance sign-off with Site Supervisor before demobilisation completion.
ppe: High-visibility shirt or vest (Class D, day work).

monitoring.frequency: continuous during boom lowering; before transport departure
monitoring.evidence: Final audit checklist signed; photographic record of boom in stowed lock position with pins visible; transport restraint certificate

inference.hrcw_category: WHS Reg 2017 Sch 3 cl.3 — Work at height with risk of fall >2m
ppe: Hard hat where overhead risk present
Energy-absorbing lanyard — double lanyard where continuous attachment required
Non-conductive PPE — where within exclusion zone
